chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Sayf ibn Ameyra, from Fayz ibn Al-Mukhtar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The redeemers are: feeding food, spreading greetings, and prayer at night while people are sleeping.

key_terms.الْمُنْجِيَاتُ: The redeemers or saviors (plural of munji)

ai.seo_question: What are the three practices that lead to salvation according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni presents this hadith as a concise triad of salvation, linking material charity (feeding), social cohesion (greeting), and spiritual devotion (night prayer). Shia scholars emphasize that these acts collectively purify the soul and strengthen the community, with night prayer specifically highlighting the believer's vigilance while the world sleeps. This combination reflects the holistic Islamic approach to salvation, balancing individual piety with social responsibility.
